lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a semi-regular grid consisting of approximately four to five horizontal rows extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at near-perpendicular angles, creating a lattice of high-luminance nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a light-reflective upper edge to a shadowed lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low density of small, faint high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-contrast white circumferential band is visible around the caudal peduncle, appearing as a sharp, linear constriction or pigment-free ring anterior to the tail.
